stories.title: Man hit by train in Kentwood, seriously injured
stories.summary: The 40-year-old man was hit in the area of 36th Street and East Paris Avenue. He was taken to a hospital in serious condition.

stories.title: 74-year-old Michigan woman scores $1 million from $10 scratch-off
stories.summary: A furniture store trip ended with a $1 million win for a 74-year-old Wayne County player. Here's what she plans to do with her winnings.

stories.title: Here's Why: Meteorological and astronomical seasons are different
stories.summary: As Dec. 1 approaches, find out how meteorological and astronomical seasons differ — and why.

stories.title: Muskegon Heights public safety millage vote delayed due to council member absences
stories.summary: Muskegon Heights City Council could not vote on a key public safety tax plan due to lack of attendance, stalling efforts to tackle a $2.5 million budget deficit.

stories.title: Wyoming house fire leaves no one hurt, including family dog
stories.summary: Firefighters battled a house fire in Wyoming Tuesday night. Fire crews said no one was injured, including the family's pet.

stories.title: 2 measles cases confirmed in Calhoun County; exposure possible at Oaklawn Hospital
stories.summary: Calhoun County health officials confirmed two measles cases. People at Oaklawn Hospital's ER waiting room Sunday night may have been exposed to the virus.

stories.title: Man seriously injured after crash with train in Ionia County
stories.summary: A 55-year-old man was seriously injured Tuesday night when his Jeep struck a train at a railroad crossing in Ionia County.

stories.title: Mona Shores football team's run to Ford Field forged by brotherhood
stories.summary: The Mona Shores Sailors have overcome hardship both on and off the field by having each other's backs. Now they can bring home a state title.

stories.title: MillerKnoll sues online furniture retailer for copyright infringement
stories.summary: The lawsuit alleges that The Essential, an online furniture retailer, engaged in unfair competition and deceptive trade practices.

stories.title: Walker Police Chief Brandyn Heugel outlines future plans, including drones, new K-9 officer
stories.summary: Brandyn Heugel, newly sworn in as Walker's police chief, plans to advance drone tech, introduce the city's first K-9 and address smart tech concerns.

stories.title: Michigan child care center faces license threat over kids playing in a puddle
stories.summary: A Michigan child care center could lose its license after LARA cited it for letting kids play in a puddle of mud. The director says the state overstepped.

stories.title: FBI turns to deceased suspect’s phone and laptop for clues in several West Michigan art heists
stories.summary: The FBI wants to search a deceased suspect’s phone and laptop to learn whether anyone else was involved in at least two West Michigan art thefts.
